name: Upstash Blob Free
free_limit: One Upstash Blob Free bucket: 1 GB monthly-average storage, 10 GB outbound bandwidth, 10,000 simple and 2,000 advanced operations/month
watch_out: Free quotas are hard caps: the bucket stops serving requests until the rolling 30-day window resets, with no Free-plan overage charge. Adding a credit card switches to pay-as-you-go billed from the first byte/operation, with NO continuing Free allowance. Reads/metadata lookups are simple operations; uploads, copies and listings are advanced; deletes are free.
